purpose: Single annual operating reference for the three-suite guest house, with financing-allocation and downside tests
publication_effect: The model does not by itself publish prices, authorize borrowing or approve the 80,000 EUR investment.

status_vocabulary.calculated_result: Arithmetic output from the stated assumptions
status_vocabulary.measurement_required: Must be replaced by a quote, recipe or timed operating test
status_vocabulary.external_validation_required: Requires written accountant, legal, tax, insurance, bank or public-authority validation

superseded_references.reading_rule: These documents remain historical evidence only. They are not active financial references.

guest_house_scope.commercial_structure: The three suites follow the same operating and pricing model.
regulatory_conditions: overnight stay and breakfast supplied together
no more than five rooms and fifteen simultaneous guests

operating_company_shareholder_current_ac.accounting_treatment: Principal repayment is a cash outflow and balance-sheet movement, not an operating expense.
operating_company_shareholder_current_ac.repayment_condition: Pay only when operating-company cash and bank covenants permit; a blocking, deferral or subordination clause may be required behind bank debt.

recommended_allocation.property_company_SCI: Borrow for building works and assets incorporated into the property, subject to the actual invoice allocation and the SCI's full debt capacity.
recommended_allocation.operating_company: Use share capital and shareholder current account for detachable furniture, operating equipment and working capital, subject to actual invoice allocation.

reference_cash_by_entity.warning: The SCI margin of 451 EUR is before all existing property debt and SCI costs. No approval is possible without the restricted consolidated debt schedule.

recommended_SCI_bank_loan.description: The SCI borrows 50,000 EUR for property works; the operating company funds detachable assets and working capital with 10,000 EUR capital and 20,000 EUR shareholder current account.
recommended_SCI_bank_loan.reading: Economically coherent with asset ownership, but the SCI has almost no standalone margin before its existing commitments.

operating_company_bank_loan_test.description: The operating company borrows the 50,000 EUR and also repays 4,000 EUR of shareholder-current-account principal.
operating_company_bank_loan_test.reading: The operating company cannot support this debt on a standalone basis. This route is also unsuitable for property-incorporated works unless a robust financing and lease agreement is validated.

stress_tests.reading: Arithmetic break-even only; not robust and not solvent by entity because the operating company is negative.
The SCI becomes negative before existing commitments; removing capital weakens the plan.
Consolidated cash is unchanged, but the operating company becomes negative. Inter-entity solvency matters more than the consolidated total.
More resilient, but it requires higher occupancy and 150 additional paid-support hours.

decision_rules: Use one three-suite model; do not apply a premium price or a separate operating structure to the Maisonnette.
Keep the public grid at 180–220 EUR, use 205 EUR as its central value and treat 210 EUR as the reference achieved average to prove.
Do not approve the 80,000 EUR plan before quotes allocate each invoice to property works, detachable assets or working capital.
Prefer SCI borrowing for property-incorporated works and operating-company funds for detachable furniture and working capital, subject to legal, tax, accounting and bank validation.
Do not repay the 20,000 EUR shareholder current account ahead of bank debt if doing so creates a liquidity shortfall; document any blocking, deferral or subordination.
Do not infer SCI debt capacity from the 451 EUR reference margin. Validate all existing SCI debt service and costs in a confidential banking annex.
Obtain bank offers including annual percentage rate, fees, insurance, security and repayment profile; the 5% rate is only a simulation assumption.
Build a named weekly roster for 2,705 modeled hours, 1 full-time equivalent Jules, 1,175 paid support hours and no more than 200 associate hours.
Keep aids and guarantees at zero until eligibility and award are confirmed in writing.

public_knowledge_excludes: exact existing property-company debt balances and terms
bank securities, guarantees, statements and lender correspondence
confidentiality.storage_rule: These data belong only in a restricted banking annex outside the public repository.
